title: Danantara Delegation Experiences JBS Australia Operations First-Hand
summary: In late August, JBS Australia welcomed Pandu Sjahrir, Chief Investment Officer and Senior executive representatives from Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund, D..)
body_markdown:
In late August, JBS Australia welcomed Pandu Sjahrir, Chief Investment Officer and Senior executive representatives from Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund, Danantara Investment Management, to several of its Australian operations, providing an opportunity for the delegation to see first-hand the scale, innovation and operational excellence that underpins the JBS Australia business.


The visit followed the recent announcement of the proposed strategic partnership between JBS and Danantara, which includes a USD$2.5 billion investment for a 25% stake in JBS's Australia and New Zealand operations and creates a platform for future growth opportunities across Indonesia, Australia, New Zealand and Southeast Asia. The transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.


Danantara representatives visited JBS facilities across multiple locations in Queensland, including Primo Foods at Brisbane, JBS Dinmore Beef at Ipswich and Beef City beef feedlot at Toowoomba. The visit provided an opportunity for the delegation to gain further insights into JBS Australia’s smallgoods/value added and beef production operations, supply chains, technology and productivity programs.


For JBS Australia, it was also an opportunity to demonstrate the passion and dedication of its team members whose efforts have helped build us as Australia's leading animal protein and food company.
